question: A bigger circle centre at O and a smaller circle centre at P touch each other externally such that the length of their common tangent LM is 12 cm. If the radius of the bigger circle is 18 cm, then what will be the radius (in cm) of the smaller circle?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ When two circles with radii **R** and **r** touch each other **externally**, the length of their **direct common tangent (LM)** is given by the formula: **LM = √(4 × R × r)** Substituting the given values: 12 = √(4 × 18 × r) ⇒ 12 = √(72 × r) Squaring both sides: 144 = 72 × r ⇒ r = 2 cm. **∴ The correct answer is 2 cm.**
